name: imf_get_ifs_data
description:
International Financial Statistics (IFS) series for one country by a friendly indicator name or an IFS code, from the IMF SDMX JSON data service (dataservices.imf.org, no API key).
Returns: database, country_code, indicator_code, frequency, data (period, value) and count; a note when the series is empty.
Inputs (* required): country_code* (ISO 2-letter); indicator (e.g. exchange_rate, policy_rate, treasury_bill_rate, cpi, core_cpi, money_supply_m2, international_reserves, gdp_current, industrial_production, unemployment_rate; list in the schema) or indicator_code (IFS code, wins over indicator); one of the two is needed; start_year and end_year (1950-2030; omit both for the full history); frequency (A, Q or M; default M).
For forecasts and annual macro aggregates use imf_get_weo_data; other databases imf_get_data.
Example: {"country_code": "GB", "indicator": "policy_rate", "start_year": 2020, "end_year": 2024}

start_year.description: First year, YYYY; if only end_year is given this defaults to 1950

end_year.description: Last year, YYYY; if only start_year is given this defaults to the current year; omit both for the full history

frequency.description: Frequency: A annual, Q quarterly, M monthly

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: International Financial Statistics provides comprehensive financial and monetary data.
